response.sql:
WITH player_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != ''
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(points_won) as avg_points_won
  FROM player_votes
  GROUP BY death_country
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as overall_avg
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT 
  ga.death_country,
  ga.avg_points_won,
  ga.avg_points_won - oa.overall_avg as distance_from_overall
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
ORDER BY ga.death_country;

assumptions.assumption: Using player_award_vote table for award vote records (not manager_award_vote), since request specifies 'matched to their players'
'Blank death_country' means NULL or empty string; both are filtered out

alternatives.interpretation: For each group, distance is measured from the average of all OTHER groups' averages (excluding the current group), rather than the global average of all groups

WITH player_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != ''
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(points_won) as avg_points_won
  FROM player_votes
  GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT 
  ga1.death_country,
  ga1.avg_points_won,
  ga1.avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_averages ga2 WHERE ga2.death_country != ga1.death_country) as distance_from_other_avg
FROM group_averages ga1
ORDER BY ga1.death_country;
